significance: An 18th-century Durga temple beside the Durga Kund tank in Varanasi, built at the expense of the Bengali queen Rani Bhabani of Natore. Its red-and-ochre exterior and adjoining stepped tank make it one of the city's most recognisable shrines.
story: The temple is said to commemorate Durga appearing on her lion to help the Kashi Naresh defeat invading kings, after which she promised to guard Varanasi.
